races.name: Navan Racecourse Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
HOWLIN WOLF continued a theme of race-by-race progression when opening his account on nursery debut at the Curragh recently and with better still to come, Jack Davison's charge earns the tentative nod to follow up. There are plenty of nursery debutants in opposition however, Supreme Lord and Prince of Peppard the pair put forward to chase him home before the benefit of market clues.

  1. HOWLIN WOLF (IRE)
  2. SUPREME LORD (IRE)
  3. PRINCE OF PEPPARD (IRE)

races.name: Navan Racing Festival Early Bird Tickets On Sale Now Handicap
races.verdict:
A fiendishly-competitive sprint in which one final chance is given to ALL THE GIRLS to prove she's as good on turf as on synthetics having run a cracker from 7 lb out of the weights when finishing runner-up at Dundalk recently. Cool Azul continues to go from strength to strength so he may well emerge as the biggest threat, with Jon Riggens and Gotta Catch'em All another couple worth considering.

  1. ALL THE GIRLS (IRE)
  2. COOL AZUL (IRE)
  3. JON RIGGENS (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
ATLANTIC BRIDGE showed plenty in a couple of maidens at the Curragh and sets a high standard. Better Yet made a promising start when splitting the more experienced Southern Boulevard and Always Magic in a maiden at Cork so Jessica Harrington's filly rates the main threat.

  1. ATLANTIC BRIDGE (IRE)
  2. BETTER YET (IRE)
  3. SOUTHERN BOULEVARD (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Optional Claiming Maiden
races.verdict:
LEADLIGHT holds some Group entries for later in the season and should make it third time lucky with sights lowered. Ger Lyons opts for another crack at a maiden with This That, who looks most interesting of the remainder.

  1. LEADLIGHT (IRE)
  2. THIS THAT
  3. EQUUS VICTOR (IRE)

races.name: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle This Saturday Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ALTO SAX has been better than the result on his last 2 outings and continues to look fairly treated on the form of his near miss at Leopardstown last month. Good Man Jack shaped quite nicely at Galway on his handicap debut given he met a bit of trouble on the home turn and this unexposed sort is second choice ahead of Colin Keane's mount Kc Bear, whose overall consistency since handicapping provides hope that he can bounce back from a lesser effort last time.

  1. ALTO SAX (IRE)
  2. GOOD MAN JACK (IRE)
  3. KC BEAR (IRE)

races.name: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle This Saturday Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
SHEREKIYA and Avec Grand Plaisir should both be getting their head in front sooner rather than later, with Dermot Weld's well-bred filly narrowly preferred on this occasion. Longseoir and Trumph also need considering in a competitive handicap.

  1. SHEREKIYA (IRE)
  2. AVEC GRAND PLAISIR (FR)
  3. LOINGSEOIR (IRE)

races.name: GAIN The Advantage Series Handicap
races.verdict:
MILLHONE arrives here in good form and the additional 1f should benefit Charles Weld's filly, so she's taken to score at the chief expense of Chicago Moon and Love Orchid.

  1. MILLHONE (IRE)
  2. CHICAGO MOON (IRE)
  3. LOVE ORCHID (IRE)

races.name: Racing Next At Navan On Saturday September 5th Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
MISS CRINSHAWN looks interesting returned to a basement-grade handicap and is taken to get off the mark stepping back up in trip. Arcland made a good start for this yard last year and is entitled to be thereabouts, while Stepdance is another to consider from a falling mark.

  1. MISS CRINSHAWN (IRE)
  2. ARCLAND (IRE)
  3. STEPDANCE (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Nursery
races.verdict:
NO MORE PINO was unlucky not to finish closer when fourth of 13 on his nursery debut at Kempton last week and, with that appealing as solid form for the grade, he's put forward as the selection. Magical Life had a few of these behind when bolting up at Kempton on her penultimate outing and is respected back down in class. Whiskey Galore has a decent pedigree and could raise his game now switching to nursery company.

  1. NO MORE PINO (IRE)
  2. MAGICAL LIFE
  3. WHISKEY GALORE

races.name: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SCRAPPETALENE shaped encouragingly on her recent Haydock debut and, with better to come over this 1f longer trip, it's reasonable to believe she can improve past standard-setter Kiah, who was seen to maximum effect when runner-up at Newmarket on her latest start. Ghaiyyath filly Please Don't Go can progress further now upped to 1m and is considered a big threat.

  1. SCRAPPETALENE
  2. PLEASE DON'T GO (IRE)
  3. KIAH (IRE)

races.name: Download The At The Races App Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The recent outing tips the scales in favour of the promising BLACK CHIFFON to get the better of returning debut winner Enoch. Colonnade looks the most interesting of the other runners.

  1. BLACK CHIFFON
  2. ENOCH (IRE)
  3. COLONNADE (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
GENERAL ASSEMBLY stands out at the weights and can make a winning return on the all-weather. Isle of Lismore remains on a handy mark and can gain second at the expense of the in-form Style King.

  1. GENERAL ASSEMBLY (IRE)
  2. ISLE OF LISMORE (IRE)
  3. STYLE KING (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
TASKHEER hasn't won for a while, but the switch to Gary & Josh Moore catches the eye so he could be worth taking a chance on in this basement-grade affair. Freedom Bay has really found her feet for new connections, so she can give the selection most to think about, with Pride Eye and Rogers Dream another couple fancied to be in the shake up, too.

  1. TASKHEER (IRE)
  2. FREEDOM BAY
  3. PRIDE EYE

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
races.verdict:
ROYAL COUNTY GLORY went within a flared nostril of making the perfect start for new connections here last week and, with this return to 7f holding no fears, Jack Jones' charge is fancied to make amends at the chief expense of Irish Fusilier, who probably needed the run making his handicap debut in June and remains with potential on all-weather bow. Melodical can get the better of Credit Forgedd It for third.

  1. ROYAL COUNTY GLORY (IRE)
  2. IRISH FUSILIER (IRE)
  3. MELODICAL

races.name: Celebrating National Racehorse Week Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ST JUST IN TIME can definitely be given another chance to get back to the form of his stable debut given the red-hot form of the Harry Derham yard. Wait At The Gate is tentatively selected to fill the forecast spot.

  1. ST JUST IN TIME
  2. WAIT AT THE GATE (IRE)
  3. NIGHTFLYER (GER)

races.name: Wotton Printers Newton Abbot Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
FLASHY BOY travelled well and would've finished closer if not for a couple of late errors at Stratford last week and he's fancied to capitalise on a lowly mark at the chief expense of Knightsbridge, who was progressing well before a change of tactics failed to pay off at Worcester last time.

  1. FLASHY BOY (IRE)
  2. KNIGHTSBRIDGE (FR)
  3. PREMIER FANTASY (IRE)

races.name: ITUS Event Support Services Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
It could be worth taking a chance on RUN AWAY JOE, who had some creditable form in points prior to last season and returns in a weak race. Buxted Reel is strongly considered following a couple of solid placed efforts earlier this summer, while Ask Peter should be more at home back in handicap company.

  1. RUN AWAY JOE (IRE)
  2. BUXTED REEL (IRE)
  3. ASK PETER (FR)

races.name: MD Elite Cleaning Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GORE POINT took a big step forward in form terms when completing the 4-timer over C&D last week and with the ceiling of his ability yet to be ascertained, Anthony Honeyball's 6-y-o is fancied to take all the beating under a penalty. Obsessedwithyou has 5 wins & 5 placed efforts from her last 10 starts so she heads up the opposition, with recent Market Rasen-scorer Gower Prince seemingly best of the rest.

  1. GORE POINT
  2. OBSESSEDWITHYOU (FR)
  3. GOWER PRINCE

races.name: Compwiz Ltd - IT Solutions For Business Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
JACK THE SAVAGE has been freshened up ahead of this and may well make it 3 wins from his previous 5 starts. My Girl Katie seeks a first hurdle win and could be dangerous off the same mark as when successful over fences here last week, while 2-time course winner Final Entry is another likely player.

  1. JACK THE SAVAGE
  2. MY GIRL KATIE (IRE)
  3. FINAL ENTRY (IRE)

races.name: Marilyn And Millie's Retirement Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
THICKTHORN TOM typically didn't do a great deal once hitting the front when making it 3 wins from his last 4 starts at Worcester 6 weeks ago but given he travelled supremely well for much of the contest, Dan Skelton's charge should still prove competitive form 5 lb higher. He gets the nod over It's A Breeze, who has been raised 15 lb for winning a couple of weak C&D races last month. McGregors Charge can fill out third.

  1. THICKTHORN TOM (IRE)
  2. IT'S A BREEZE (IRE)
  3. MCGREGORS CHARGE

races.name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Veteran C&D winner DONNIE AZOFF arrives in good heart and looks the most likely winner. Ellerton can emerge as the lead threat.

  1. DONNIE AZOFF (IRE)
  2. ELLERTON (FR)
  3. KING OF THE BRONX (IRE)

races.name: Morgan's Army Fighting Spirit Nursery
races.verdict:
LAYLATY did well to reel in a subsequent winner when making a winning nursery bow at Lingfield (turf) so she looks capable of defying a 4 lb rise. Downonmainstreet also looks progressive and she rates the main threat.

  1. LAYLATY
  2. DOWNONMAINSTREET (IRE)
  3. TANGO HOTEL

races.name: Shirgar Welsh Butter Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TUMISHI sets a decent standard and can put his experience to good use up against a couple of interesting newcomers in Duchess of Immatin and Corbie Rock.

  1. TUMISHI
  2. DUCHESS OF IMMATIN (IRE)
  3. CORBIE ROCK (IRE)

races.name: CJCH Solicitors Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
A weak but open event with a chance taken on OUTER EDGE dropped to this level. Macarone and Mayflower Rock head the dangers.

  1. OUTER EDGE
  2. MACARONE
  3. MAYFLOWER ROCK

races.name: Roly Poly Events Race Of Hope Handicap
races.verdict:
The progressive LAST FLIGHT only just failed to make a winning start for this yard at Lingfield and she is fancied to make amends. Veterans Lusaka, Golden Flame and Merrijig are feared most.

  1. LAST FLIGHT
  2. LUSAKA (IRE)
  3. GOLDEN FLAME (IRE)

races.name: BNI Elli Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A tough call but BLUE HERCULES is marginally preferred following a couple of fairly useful efforts in Ascot handicaps recently. Winday makes a belated return to the Flat for his shrewd Irish yard (first runner at this track) and is feared, especially if supported.

  1. BLUE HERCULES (IRE)
  2. WINDAY (FR)
  3. PHANTOM RECON (IRE)

races.name: EX1 Digital Forensic Services Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
GRAND PIER looks the percentage call following his close second over C&D in June. Fast Steps could be the main danger if ridden with a bit more restraint. Revich, Takeitorleaveit and Symphony's Song are others to consider in an open-looking finale.

  1. GRAND PIER
  2. FAST STEPS (IRE)
  3. REVICH (IRE)

races.name: Paul Kavanagh Memorial AJA Novice Flat Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
EPIDAVROS is down to a mark she should be able to capitalise on and might be able to turn around recent Hamilton form with Sanafi Zabeel. Spirit Catcher is next on the list.

  1. EPIDAVROS (IRE)
  2. SANAFI ZABEEL (FR)
  3. SPIRIT CATCHER (IRE)

races.name: Celebrating National Racehorse Week 2026 EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Those with experience don't set the bar too high so there's a chance this will go to one of the newcomers. BENBECULA is bred to go a bit and is preferred to Blazing Inferno and Karl Burke pair Mehmas Star and Five Years before any betting clues are known.

  1. BENBECULA (IRE)
  2. BLAZING INFERNO (IRE)
  3. MEHMAS STAR (IRE)

races.name: Colin Parker Raceday 1st Nov Nursery
races.verdict:
KANZI appeals as one who can go on improving on the back of her Lingfield success and is narrowly preferred to Epsom scorer Bincimbal and Karl Burke's Ten Clarets, who has proved expensive to follow so far but may benefit from this longer trip.

  1. KANZI
  2. BINCIMBAL (IRE)
  3. TEN CLARETS (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Community Raceday 13th Dec Handicap
races.verdict:
A few of these offer potential but GO VINCE GO brings some solid handicap form to the table and is fancied to gain a deserved first win of 2026. Karl Burke's handicap debutant Town Queen looks ready to take another step forward and rates a big threat, although the David and Nicola Barron-trained duo Here Forever and Tip Foster appeal as likely improvers too and can also play a prominent role.

  1. GO VINCE GO (IRE)
  2. TOWN QUEEN (IRE)
  3. HERE FOREVER

races.name: Ladies Night 2027 On Sale Now Handicap
races.verdict:
Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and HARRY MOLE is taken to gain a deserved breakthrough success after a string of good efforts. Crafty Spirit is enjoying a good 2026 and seems sure to go well once more, while Supremissy and Opal Storm also need considering.

  1. HARRY MOLE
  2. CRAFTY SPIRIT (IRE)
  3. SUPREMISSY (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again Wednesday 9th Sept Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
This is wide open and it could be worth siding with TAYLORMADE LAD who took this prize a year ago off a 2 lb higher mark and should prove suited by stepping back up in trip after his latest Ayr seventh. Vampire Slayer is next on the list back in this sphere after a layoff with the potential for improvement having improved over hurdles in the winter. Riddikulus and Dr Rio also need factoring in.

  1. TAYLORMADE LAD (IRE)
  2. VAMPIRE SLAYER (IRE)
  3. RIDDIKULUS

races.name: Racing Again Wednesday 9th Sept Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
IDYLLIC rates just the pick of the weights on the back of a good third at Ayr so this C&D scorer edges the vote from in-form maiden Lightning Galaxy who came in just a place behind Wilf Storey's mare that day. Both Falaise Blanc and Annandale need factoring into this very open handicap too.

  1. IDYLLIC
  2. LIGHTNING GALAXY (IRE)
  3. FALAISE BLANC (FR)

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
HERETIC is drawn widest but should still prove capable of defying a penalty for winning over 1m here 11 days ago. Dumfries shaped as if back in form at Beverley last time and is also considered, alongside Turbo Command, who has a good record at C&D.

  1. HERETIC (IRE)
  2. DUMFRIES
  3. TURBO COMMAND (IRE)

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ADELAIDE BAY has been pretty expensive to follow since rejoining Chapple-Hyam but this doesn't look much of a race and he can build on last month's encouraging fourth at Newcastle to notch an overdue first success of the year. Respectable Jack and King Sharja are also shortlisted.

  1. ADELAIDE BAY
  2. RESPECTABLE JACK
  3. KING SHARJA

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap
races.verdict:
No shortage of chances in a competitive affair but CARRON found only a subsequent winner too strong on his final start for George Boughey at Yarmouth in June and, boasting a particularly appealing record on all-weather (3 wins from 4 starts) he could be the answer on debut for Ruth Carr. That said, Mr Noble and Haaderr are 2 improving 3-y-os who command plenty of respect, with Pietro another needing consideration back from a break.

  1. CARRON (IRE)
  2. MR NOBLE (IRE)
  3. HAADERR

races.name: Follow attheraces On Instagram Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Group 2 entrant NIGHT OF GOLD ticks plenty of boxes on paper representing the George Boughey/Billy Loughnane combination and he could be worth siding with to score at the first time of asking before market clues. Market Leader stands out of those with prior experience and is going the right way so he commands obvious respect also, whilst El Morjan is another appealing debutant hailing from the Gosden stable.

  1. NIGHT OF GOLD
  2. MARKET LEADER (IRE)
  3. EL MORJAN

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Nursery
races.verdict:
NOUR brings a positive profile to nurseries, building on her debut effort when posting a very good third in a York novice 33 days ago. Starting out in handicaps from what looks a workable mark and open to further progress, she shades preference over recent Wolverhampton scorer Trust Yourself. Lord Ragnar is another to consider in what is an interesting race of its type.

  1. NOUR (IRE)
  2. TRUST YOURSELF (IRE)
  3. LORD RAGNAR (IRE)

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
MASSIMO BLUE escapes a penalty for last week's win here and should go close to following up. Fenlander has finished in the placings on all 3 visits to the track and has improved on turf since, so is respected back at Southwell, whilst Miraculous arrives in good heart and also holds claims in a decent race for the grade.

  1. MASSIMO BLUE
  2. FENLANDER
  3. MIRACULOUS (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips Daily On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
The 3-y-os look to hold a strong hand here and rate the pair to focus on. CAPTAIN CAIRNEY got back on the up and displayed a good attitude in the process when defeating a next-time-out winner at Leicester 4 weeks ago and shades preference over Worlington who looks worthy of a try at this trip. Currumbin is another to keep an eye on returned to a longer distance from his reduced mark.

  1. CAPTAIN CAIRNEY
  2. WORLINGTON
  3. CURRUMBIN (IRE)

Prix De La Villa Lucie Handicap - Awt
